reviewer: Codex AI visual diagnostic, not human review
method: All 144 images inspected on 24 shuffled A-F contact sheets, with 32px thumbnails. Condition map withheld until this observation file was complete. Development prompts, not a sealed test; subjective ordinal scores, not calibrated probabilities.

scoring.2: Major requested details clearly present, no obvious material defect
scoring.1: Recognizable but missing/ambiguous requested detail or uncertain geometry
scoring.0: Major prompt failure or clearly defective geometry

dev-collection-01-seed-0.notes: B has smiling eyes and forehead sweat, though drop is blobby. A/D/F place a tear-like drop below an open eye. C/E omit the drop.

dev-collection-01-seed-1.notes: A/C/E retain blue forehead sweat and smiling eyes. B/D/F have a yellow forehead protrusion, ambiguous as sweat at small size.

dev-collection-02-seed-0.notes: All are coherent sad faces, but watery pleading eyes are weak or missing.

dev-collection-02-seed-1.notes: B/E/F have upturned brows and glossy eyes, clearer pleading than the flat-eyed A/C/D.

dev-collection-03-seed-0.notes: All show a single raised finger rather than visibly crossed index and middle fingers.

dev-collection-03-seed-1.notes: All show a single raised finger. Some also have ambiguous digit counts.

dev-collection-04-seed-0.notes: All show a single raised finger, not crossed fingers; A/B darker than the others.

dev-collection-04-seed-1.notes: All show a single raised finger, not crossed fingers.

dev-collection-05-seed-0.notes: D has two parallel raised digits, not crossed. All others show one raised digit.

dev-collection-05-seed-1.notes: All show one raised digit; D/E visibly darker but still wrong gesture.

dev-collection-06-seed-0.notes: All retain a dark skin tone but show one raised digit rather than crossed fingers.

dev-collection-06-seed-1.notes: All show one raised digit rather than crossed fingers.

dev-collection-07-seed-0.notes: All retain dark tones but show one raised digit, not crossed fingers.

dev-collection-07-seed-1.notes: All show one raised digit, not crossed fingers.

dev-collection-08-seed-0.notes: All have coherent medium-tone faces and yellow/orange helmets. Firefighter identity is ambiguous with construction-worker hard hats, especially A/C/F.

dev-collection-08-seed-1.notes: Coherent faces and helmets throughout; black band improves detail but firefighter versus construction worker remains ambiguous.

dev-collection-09-seed-0.notes: All clearly recognizable single pink backpacks with rounded pockets and yellow zipper accents, including at 32px.

dev-collection-09-seed-1.notes: All retain requested colors and backpack silhouette. A has doubled zipper bars; E handle is mostly occluded, neither a major failure.

dev-collection-10-seed-0.notes: B handlebar visibly disconnected. All others recognizable with two wheels, but pedals/axle connections are missing or unclear. D/F have more mechanical detail but very small framing.

dev-collection-10-seed-1.notes: All recognizable red two-wheel bicycles, but no unambiguously complete pedal geometry. A retains spokes/tires; most others use pale rings, and C wheels look button-like.

dev-collection-11-seed-0.notes: All read as symmetrical folded/praying hands rather than an unambiguous high-five from two people. Some have fused or extra-looking fingertips.

dev-collection-11-seed-1.notes: All are folded/praying hands, explicitly excluded by the requested criterion.

dev-collection-12-seed-0.notes: None link only little fingers. A/B/C/E add bright pink finger-like objects; D/F resemble fist contact with thumbs down.

dev-collection-12-seed-1.notes: A/B/D/E touch bent index-like fingers or knuckles, not linked little fingers. C/F touch pink fingertips without linking; requested tone contrast is also weak.
